system.flavor:
Climb a rough stone wall with one hand free, score your mark into a doorframe, cut a rope or a strap, pry the lid off a crate, or shred a sack to get at what is inside.

Not enough to cut through a lock or scale a smooth face.

surges.html: Move 1 unit around the target after the attack.

rider.title: Adaptation - Predator
rider.html: Assume Hooked Talons (upkeep 0): you can climb rough surfaces at normal Movement, but must keep one hand free while climbing.
